observed_problem: The original retry policy applied the same automatic retry semantics to local deterministic work and external workflow dispatch.
expected_behavior: Retry policy is action-kind/stage-specific; WORKFLOW_DISPATCH is non-retryable by default and retry requires explicit idempotency or reconciliation authority.
actual_behavior: An ambiguous external dispatch failure could be retried and launch duplicate work.
improvement_action: Split retry policies by action kind and require explicit idempotency authority before a workflow dispatch may be retried.
